Henry James, The Turn of the Screw.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/henry-james/the-turn-of-the-screw

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Henry James, the author, died 1916.

First publication of the text used: 1898 (serial in Collier's Weekly, a United States magazine, from 27 January to 16 April 1898; the book followed on 7 October 1898 from Macmillan in New York and Heinemann in London). SE colophon: 'The Turn of the Screw was published in 1898 by Henry James.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1898, before 1931, in the United States. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1993.
- Country of origin (United States): the first publication was in the United States before 1931, so the US rule settles the origin too, whatever the death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
